instruction: I made venmo payment requests to some of my friends yesterday evening. Unfortunately, I have made a mistake in calculation. Each of them owes me $5 less than the requested amount. So delete those requests and make new ones with everything else the same, but with the corrected amount.
notes: The set of payment requests sent yesterday evening (2023-05-19) is unknown a priori; it is discovered by venmo.show_sent_payment_requests (filter by created_at), modeled with the knowledge predicate (requests-listed) that gates all per-request actions. The problem assumes two such requests (the reference solution's 9 calls fit two requests plus a paginated listing); the ground truth implies all requests share the same amount and description, so one original amount, one corrected amount and one description object are shared. The $5 correction is encoded as the static relation (minus-five original corrected) instead of numeric fluents. Each request must be deleted and re-created with the same receiver email, description and privacy flag but the corrected amount; no ordering between delete and create is enforced since the evaluation only checks the final added/removed records. supervisor-complete-task takes the two request records as non-API parameters so its precondition can state the full goal; it is the last action and the only one producing (task-completed). Pagination of the listing is not modeled.

plan: (venmo-create-payment-request email-friend-1 amount-corrected venmo-token dinner-description privacy-as-before request-friend-1 friend-1 amount-requested)
(venmo-create-payment-request email-friend-2 amount-corrected venmo-token dinner-description privacy-as-before request-friend-2 friend-2 amount-requested)
